Step seven: check and output. Look at the Tasks page first. When every square is green, the show is complete.
The last step of Setup lists the open issues, and links to the Signal Flow, the PDF and the stickers.
Export PDF opens the report builder. Choose the sections: the patch, the racks, the signal flow, the network, the switch ports and the fibre links.
New: the QR codes section. Every DB gets QR codes that hold the whole DB as text, and the first page can carry one for the whole system.
A live preview shows every page before you export. Then export, and you have the report, ready to print or to send.
